description: Ambient NPC life for Gen2Recomped: wandering humans and Pokemon, daily routines, agendas, sleep, lifelike behaviors, conversations, companions, fly/teleport/surf departures, and 5th-interaction events (item gifts, trades, battles, wild encounters) across Generations 1-4. Gen 4 (Platinum) support is experimental.
name: Kanto Life for Gen2Recomped
